description: This source file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Custom, which is a part of the HTMLPurifier library. It implements custom child element validation logic based on DTD regex patterns, including regex compilation and child validation methods.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Custom
classes.description: A class that defines custom validation for DTD child definitions in the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a DTD regex pattern and compiles the internal PCRE regex.

methods.name: _compileRegex
methods.description: Converts the DTD regex into a PCRE-compatible regex, preparing it for validation.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates a list of child nodes against the compiled regex pattern to ensure correct DTD conformance.
